besluite.fout: 'Verf gaan ... op 'n muur aan' is a loose, colloquial use of 'aangaan' that can make a reader stumble.
besluite.rede: 'word ... aangebring' is the standard verb for applying paint and says the same thing; 'Dit' in the next sentence still points to the paint.
